label: First Way necessary first root witnesses the necessary first PURE_ACT_5 endpoint (inference)
meaning: The first mover that is a necessary actual first pure-act root is in particular some necessary actual first pure-act root of the same profile: drop the first-mover conjunct. This connects the First Way, through its own witness, to the existing endpoint consumed by the necessary-first-attributes argument, without any identification of the first mover with an independently derived necessary root (B7).
